notes: ClassicUO screen math in world units (1 unit = 1 tile side; x east, y north, z up): screen x = 22(x + y), screen y = 22(x - y) - 31.1127 z. Equivalent to an orthographic camera at 45 deg elevation looking north-west with the render stretched vertically by sqrt(2). Matches the ground grid exactly; it is not proven to be the camera the character art was drawn/rendered with.
